decisions.rationale: The mint budget clock started after the stale-runner sweep and did not count the final in-flight request, so ExecStartPre could exceed TimeoutStartSec=900. One clock now starts before any API call; the sweep is capped at half the budget; a request is started only if it can finish (GX10_MINT_REQ_MAX, curl --max-time) inside GX10_MINT_MAX_ELAPSED; the non-retryable hold-off is clipped to the remaining budget. Composite bound test (max_elapsed + req_max < TimeoutStartSec, hold-off <= budget, clock before sweep) and a clipping test added.
